## About
Home Team Painters is an independently owned painting company based in Stone Oak, serving homes and businesses around San Antonio. Our crew shows up prepared, sticks to the quote, and leaves the work site clean or better than we found it.
Tom Cerrone, the owner, stays close to every job, and a manager or foreman is on site to answer questions as the work goes. We help with picking and matching colors, and before we leave we make sure you are happy with the finished result.
We are licensed and insured and we warranty our work. Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 34 Google reviews.

## Services
- Exterior house painting: Exterior painting for your home, done with attention to detail and quality paint.
- Interior house painting: Whole-home or room-by-room interior painting, with care taken to protect everything that is not getting paint.
- Kitchen cabinet painting: Painting and refinishing your cabinets instead of replacing them.
- Commercial property painting: Interior and exterior painting for commercial buildings, strip centers and retail shopping centers.
- Garage painting or man cave conversion: Brighten a work area or reset the look with darker tones, alternating colors and textured floors.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Call us or send a message through the site and request a free estimate.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are based in Stone Oak and work throughout the greater San Antonio area.

Q: Do you offer flexible schedules?
A: Yes. We work with clients on flexible schedules so the job gets done on time.
